name: Gearbox
text: Switch EXCAVA to Anthropic’s latest Claude 3.7 Sonnet. It’s the only model that delivers a measurable jump in reasoning depth without adding latency—proven on complex power-grid optimization tasks. The trade-off is higher cost per token, but the 0.7% lift in EXCAVA’s solver accuracy outweighs the burn.

name: Torque
text: The real risk isn’t just cost—it’s benchmark drift. EXCAVA’s live task accuracy depends on stable, repeatable benchmarks, and Anthropic’s 3.7 Sonnet hasn’t been stress-tested on our domain yet. A controlled A/B swap with a 24-hour burn-in on synthetic power-grid tasks would settle it: if the lift holds without regression, proceed; if not, default to the proven 3.5 Haiku with a custom fine-tune.
